Description: Members and Candidates must understand and comply with all applicable laws, rules, and regulations.
Maintain independence and objectivity, avoid conflicts of interest or undue influence.
Do not knowingly make any misrepresentations relating to investment analysis, recommendations, actions, or other professional activities.
Do not engage in any professional conduct involving dishonesty, fraud, deceit, or commit any act that reflects adversely on professional reputation.
Do not act or cause others to act on material nonpublic information.
Do not engage in practices that distort prices or artificially inflate trading volume to mislead market participants.
Prudence
column6: Act for the benefit of clients and place clients' interests before your own.

Description: Deal fairly and objectively with all clients when providing investment analysis, making recommendations, or taking investment action.
Make recommendations and take investment actions that are suitable to the client’s financial situation and objectives.
Make reasonable efforts to ensure investment performance information is fair, accurate, and complete.
Keep information about current, former, and prospective clients confidential unless the information concerns illegal activities or disclosure is required by law.
Act for the benefit of your employer and do not deprive your employer of your skills or divulge confidential information.
Do not accept gifts, benefits, or compensation that might create a conflict with your employer's interests unless you obtain written consent.
Ensure that anyone subject to your supervision complies with applicable laws, rules, regulations, and the Code and Standards.
Exercise diligence, independence, and thoroughness in analyzing investments and have a reasonable basis for investment recommendations.

Subsection: V(B) Communication with Clients and Prospective Clients
Description: Disclose the general principles of the investment processes used and distinguish between fact and opinion.
Develop and maintain appropriate records to support investment analyses, recommendations, actions, and other investment-related communications.
Make full and fair disclosure of all matters that could reasonably be expected to impair independence and objectivity.
Investment transactions for clients must have priority over transactions in which a member or candidate is the beneficial owner.
Members and candidates must disclose to their employer, clients, and prospective clients any compensation, consideration, or benefit received from, or paid to, others.

StandardName: Responsibilities as a CFA Institute Member or CFA Candidate
Subsection: VII(A) Conduct as Participants in CFA Institute Programs
Description: Do not compromise the integrity of CFA Institute programs, and abide by all applicable rules and policies.
